oliver (support): FYI customer (acme) opened a P1 — users get repeated MFA prompts after enrolling device trust. Happens ~60s after initial successful sign-in. Repro steps and screenshots attached by CS.
maria (sre): @oliver :eyes: any request/response logs? sounds like session cookie might not be persisting behind the new edge proxy
oliver (support): Pasting minimal repro we ran against staging with the same proxy config. Note the Set-Cookie from /auth returns SameSite=None; Secure and Expires present, but downstream response to client is missing Secure and becomes session-only.
```
> Request: POST /auth/mfa/complete
> Response (origin): Set-Cookie: rwsess=eyJ...; Path=/; Domain=.acme.com; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=None; Expires=Tue, 17 Mar 2026 12:34:56 GMT
```
```
# What client actually receives (from proxy):
Set-Cookie: rwsess=eyJ...; Path=/; Domain=.acme.com; HttpOnly; SameSite=None
# -> No Secure, no Expires => treated as session cookie, dropped on some mobile webviews / cross-site contexts
```
oliver (support): Also seeing frequent 401s in the token service logs right after Set-Cookie is issued. Example from auth-service:
```
2026-03-17T12:35:58Z WARN token-validate - token missing kvcache for sid=abc123; origin=auth-service; client_ip=10.2.3.4
2026-03-17T12:36:00Z INFO session-expire - session lookup expired for sid=abc123 (ttl 60s)
```
maria (sre): That ttl 60s log is suspicious. Are we double-applying a short session TTL when device-trust transitions complete? @tim did we recently roll a cookie-affinity config for the edge that strips Secure when `preserve_headers=false`?
tim (eng): I rolled a change last week to normalize Set-Cookie headers for legacy backends: I added a sanitizer that drops unknown attributes when upstream sends malformed flags. Looks like it may be misclassifying `Expires` as unknown and reserializing without Secure/Expires. I'll dig in.
oliver (support): Customer repro notes: occurs for users on mobile embedded webview (iOS WKWebView) and Chrome with SameSite enforcement enabled. Desktop Chrome sometimes fine. Workaround CS provided: open in full browser or disable the proxy path for /auth endpoints.
maria (sre): Can we confirm two things from the proxy logs: 1) whether `Set-Cookie` header is rewritten, 2) whether the response is served over https vs http (Secure dropped if proxy downgrades). If proxy is terminating TLS then reissuing without Secure, that's a bug.
rwb-ci-bot: deploy 2287.654 -> edge-proxy-sanitizer succeeded (triggered by tim) :white_check_mark:
tim (eng): repro steps local: spin edge-proxy with sanitizer config:
```
edge-proxy --sanitize-set-cookie=true --preserve-attributes=none --port=8443
# then curl with host header and observe
curl -k -v -H 'Host: acme.com' https://localhost:8443/auth/mfa/complete
```
tim (eng): Quick fix options:
- revert sanitizer change (removes normalization) -> short-term mitigation
- update sanitizer whitelist to preserve Secure and Expires attributes -> safer fix
- add automated integration test covering Set-Cookie roundtrip for SameSite/secure cases
maria (sre): Also adding request to check token TTL assignment path in auth-service post-MFA to ensure we're not mistakenly issuing a 60s session for device-trust flows.
oliver (support): Customer impact: affects ~8% of sign-ins (mobile-first team). They've requested a rollback on the edge change or a config toggle. CS asked for an ETA for fix/rollback and suggested mitigation doc we can share.
tim (eng): I'll push a hotfix to preserve attributes and run canary. ETA ~2 hours to rollout a config change + canary. Will post canary logs.
maria (sre): I'll coordinate with CS on mitigation text: explain full-browser fallback and temporary disablement of proxy passthrough for /auth. Also adding monitoring alert for session TTL anomalies (>60s warnings).
oliver (support): Thanks — please @mention me when canary shows Set-Cookie includes Secure and Expires in downstream response. I'll update the customer and ask them to verify mobile webview behavior.
tim (eng): canary log (will update):
```
# after fix
Client receives: Set-Cookie: rwsess=eyJ...; Path=/; Domain=.acme.com; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=None; Expires=Tue, 17 Mar 2026 12:45:00 GMT
# auth-service shows no immediate 401s for sid=abc123
```
oliver (support): Awesome. Marking this thread to follow until customer verifies. If fix doesn't hold we'll schedule rollback.
maria (sre): Adding follow-up: run synthetic sign-in from mobile webview once canary is live to validate persistence across tabs and backgrounding.
oliver (support): noted. Closing internal escalation once customer confirms. Thanks everyone. :pray:
